product_metadata.title: Seville Classics Heavy Duty Fitted Wire Shelf Liners Water-Resistant Protector Mat, Non-Adhesive, for Wired Shelves, Office, Kitchen, Garage (2 Pieces), Semi-Transparent Taupe, fits 18" x 18" Shelf
features: 2-PACK - Set includes 2 liners that measure 17.25" x 17.25" x .02" thick (each) and fit 18” x 18” wire shelves.
FLEXIBLE DURABILITY - These tough and flexible shelf liners are 100% heavy duty polypropylene and are a semi-transparent taupe color.

SOLID VERSATILE SURFACE – These solid, flexible liners provide a smooth and even surface on wire shelves that help prevent small items from falling and unwanted liquid spills from leaking onto lower shelves or the floor. They may also be easily trimmed with a strong household scissor to custom fit a cabinet or space.
EASY TO CLEAN – These liners are non-adhesive and are easily removable for cleaning. They are water-resistant and can be cleaned with most multi-purpose disinfectants.
CUSTOM FIT – This 2-pack of liners are a custom fit for Seville Classics 18” x 18” wire shelves. They also fit most wire shelves on the market.
description: This 2-pack of tough and flexible Seville Classics shelf liners are 100% heavy duty polypropylene in a semi-transparent taupe color. Designed to give your wire shelves a flat and smooth platform making it easier to store small parts and prevent unwanted spillage from falling through to the lower shelves. Our liners are flexible, durable, and water-resistant for easy sanitization purposes. Both liners measure 17.25" x 17.25" and fit best with Seville Classics 18" x 18" steel wire shelves. They will also fit most wire shelves on the market. Enhance your home storage, pantry, garage, stockroom, or warehouse with Seville Classics universal shelf liner set. The liners may be trimmed to fit other spaces, just note that altering a product can affect warranty. Specifications Dimensions: 17.25" W x 17.25" L x .02" thick (each); Model #: WEB273
